finding_1: balance() keeps min(class sizes) per class, so the 'balanced only' recipe of the recipe comparison used all 15813 label-0 records (it trained on 31626 = 2 x 15813): none is unused.
finding_2: Unused records can only have label 1; 0 of 26208 have a project name, so their repository identity cannot be checked against the test projects.
finding_3: The other Python-tagged train records (11969) are negatives that failed the content filter; adding them would tie the label to 'parses as Python' and bias the gate evaluation.
decision: Part 3.9 not run: no verifiable never-used held-out set with both classes exists. Test and dev samples are not substituted (D41).
